Machine mapping: 1 MRA files in the repository's releases/ directory carry a <setname>; 1 resolved exactly to a MAME 0.288 machine and 0 through MAME's own cloneof relation to the parent set that survives extract/machine.json's parents-only filter, giving 1 distinct machine_id rows. license_id omitted: the repository has no LICENSE, COPYING or COPYRIGHT file and no license grant was found in the HDL headers read (Arcade-Jackal.sv). hdl_language_id: no single HDL family reaches 90% of the 48 source files (8 systemverilog, 38 verilog, 2 vhdl), excluding the shared framework directory. accuracy_id omitted: the repository makes no timing-fidelity claim this build could verify.
